nodes.label: Layout Check (Names-Down/Dates-Across vs One-Row-Per-Shift)
nodes.rationale: Month/year confirmation required; weekday letters are checked against the chosen month; skipped rows like totals are reviewed.

nodes.label: Import Review Step (Totals, Warnings, Side-by-Side Compare)
nodes.norm_label: import review step (totals, warnings, side-by-side compare)

nodes.label: Shift Code Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Every distinct entry is listed and confirmed by the user, with optional times.

nodes.label: Spaced Leave-Word Detection (A N N U A L)
nodes.norm_label: spaced leave-word detection (a n n u a l)
nodes.rationale: Leave words spelled one letter per cell must be confirmed, otherwise 'A' would be read as Afternoon and 'N' as Night.

nodes.label: src/lib/interpret (Layout, Draft, Leave, Codes, Final Roster)
nodes.norm_label: src/lib/interpret (layout, draft, leave, codes, final roster)

nodes.label: Explicit Empty-Cell Meaning
nodes.rationale: Blanks are never treated as days off unless the user says so.

nodes.label: src/views (Dashboard, Calendar, Agenda, Day View, Name Picker, Roster Info)
nodes.norm_label: src/views (dashboard, calendar, agenda, day view, name picker, roster info)

nodes.label: Hash Routing & Relative Paths
nodes.rationale: Lets the build work under any GitHub Pages repository name.

nodes.label: Inline SVG Heart Favicon
nodes.rationale: Embedded as data URI so no external request is needed.

nodes.label: Privacy Meta Tags (no-referrer, noindex/nofollow)
nodes.rationale: Prevents referrer leakage and search-engine indexing of the private roster viewer.

nodes.label: Content Security Policy connect-src 'none'
nodes.rationale: Production build forbids network connections so the page cannot send data anywhere.

nodes.label: Local Real-Roster Sample Test (tests/local-sample.test.ts)
nodes.rationale: Real files kept outside the repo via ROSTER_SAMPLE_DOCX/PDF env vars; prints counts only, never names.

nodes.label: .gitignore Excludes Roster Files
nodes.rationale: Excludes *.pdf, *.docx, *.xlsx, *.xls, *.csv so real rosters can't be committed by accident.

nodes.label: On-Device Privacy (No Upload/Server)
nodes.rationale: Files are read in the browser; no server, analytics or third-party service, to keep personal roster data private.

nodes.label: Read-Only Roster Viewing
nodes.rationale: App only reads a roster; it cannot create/edit rosters, assign shifts, or handle swaps, and never changes the original file.
